'''Keep Le Faye''' is a tower south of [[Camelot Castle]], and directly east of [[Sorcerer's Tower]]. It plays a large role in the [[Merlin's Crystal]] and [[King's Ransom]] [[quests]]. The keep is the home of [[Morgan Le Faye]].

==Transportation==
*Teleport to [[Camelot]] and run south
*Use [[fairy ring]] code {{fairycode|blr}} and run north-east
*Use the [[Kandarin headgear 3]]/[[Kandarin headgear_4|4]] teleport to [[Sherlock]] and run east
*Use the [[Ardougne cloak 2]]/[[Ardougne cloak 3|3]]/[[Ardougne cloak 4|4]] teleport to [[Ardougne]] farm and run east
*Hide in the crate outside of the [[Candle Shop]] in [[Catherby]]

== Quests ==

=== Merlin's Crystal ===
In Merlin's Crystal, players must hide inside the crates near the candle shop in Catherby. Workers will load the crates onto a boat that brings the player to the keep, after which players must defeat [[Sir Mordred]]. After beating him in combat, [[Morgan Le Faye]] will appear and ask you to spare her son, which players will do in exchange for information on freeing [[Merlin]].

=== King's Ransom ===
After breaking out of jail during King's Ransom, players end up on the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} of the keep, surrounded by knights in battle. With the Renegade Knights occupied, players can head to the top and obtain the [[Holy grail (item)|holy grail]].

==Inhabitants==
*[[Renegade Knight]]s (level 37)
*[[Sir Mordred]] (Level 39)
